grants.name: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship (GRFP)
grants.notes: Applies to first- and second-year PhD students and seniors. The computer and information sciences deadline is usually the third week of October.
grants.typical_window: Applications usually open in August and close in late October, with a different deadline per field. Solicitation NSF 26-526.
